usedFor: Shopify holds orders, and Pipl.ai runs campaigns, so “New Order” can add a lead with “Add leads to a campaign”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Shopify, then “Add leads to a campaign” in Pipl.ai
bestTemplate.why: Each new order sends the buyer into a campaign, so follow-up starts without a manual list.

watchOut: “Add leads to a campaign” needs a campaign to exist already, so create it first.
